purpose: define the teacher gate and teacher contract required before any T2 recovery-distribution data discussion

negative_evidence_addressed.recovery_oracle_cross_pose_failure: gate stage G2 requires all registered tuning poses to be solved before anything downstream opens
negative_evidence_addressed.geometry_teacher_safe_but_non_progressin: gate stage G3 measures recovery progress from deviated states directly; safety alone cannot pass
negative_evidence_addressed.time_indexed_labels_invalid_after_deviat: teacher contract forbids time, trajectory-index, episode-id and seed inputs

teacher_contract.output: one absolute standard-space action under the unchanged Action Contract

gate_stages.G0: static contract conformance including non-degenerate refusal region
gate_stages.G1: exact calibration reproduction within budget with zero safety violations; insufficient by design
gate_stages.G2: cross-pose generalization on the reserved tuning-seed group; proposal 5/5 poses within per-pose budget
gate_stages.G3: recovery from deviated states; proposal >=3 perturbed states per pose, <=150-action recovery budget, refusal rate <=10%
gate_stages.G4: boundary honesty on registered negative suite; zero silent defaults
